concerns.location: plan.md:Performance Goals section (line ~45) & Compute Feasibility Summary (line ~120)
concerns.text: The plan asserts a full CPU‑only pipeline ≤ 6 h wall‑clock with a 50 M‑parameter diffusion student model trained for ≤ 20 epochs on ~10 k sequences. Empirically, training a diffusion model of this size on CPU (even with batch‑size 8) typically exceeds 12 h on a GitHub Actions free runner, making the stated compute budget unrealistic. This violates the methodology requirement that the approach be runnable within the free‑compute constraints.
